authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The full sarva entry gives Bashkarik sō/sūo, Lahnda/Pothwari habbā/habbh, Nepali/Bengali sab, Oriya sabo/sabu and Assamese sɔb/xɔb; it explicitly discusses irregular pronominal h/s and b developments. These whole all-forms fit that series, with final agreement/emphatic vowels retained. Multiword totality expressions and the unrelated-looking saf/bekti series are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s lamba family combines the regional lamb-/lām- long series with Maithili namā, documenting an n-initial variant within the family. The western nāmb-/ṇāmb- survey adjectives preserve the matching medial mb and ordinary final agreement. This is a qualified comparative-family assignment: the local n/l alternation is not presented as a fully established regular sound law, and further -la extensions remain excluded.
